purpose: Keep transformations derived from the same two-dimensional source image in one classifier split while documenting that patient/scan/series separation cannot be guaranteed without metadata.

decision_codes.same_source: Same 2D source content or an augmentation derived from it; create a family edge.
decision_codes.independent: Different 2D source content; do not create a family edge.
decision_codes.uncertain: Evidence is insufficient; do not create an automatic family edge and route to adjudication.

metadata_limitation.required_report_statement: Patient/scan/series identifiers are unavailable, so residual patient-level overlap cannot be ruled out. The leakage-aware split controls exact copies and detected same-2D augmentation families.

historical_evidence_note: The frozen v2.5 result remains failed under its broader acquisition-family visual interpretation. This target applies prospectively to the accelerated split pipeline and does not rewrite v2.5 decisions.
